summary.intent: Execute all 9 plans across 4 waves of GSD phase 71 (Share-Invite Security & IPNS Data-Integrity API) via wave-based parallel subagent orchestration, then run the full autonomous post-execution ship loop (verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit, ship, resolve PR reviews, extract learnings).
summary.outcome: All 9 plans executed and merged across 4 waves with every gate green (typecheck, 894/894 api tests, cargo check, sdk-core/sdk tests); phase verification passed 16/16 truths with 0 gaps. In the ship loop, verify/secure/validate/simplify steps completed, but the SDK E2E gate caught a real regression (D-05 same-seq CID guard incorrectly rejecting a legitimate forward-CAS race with 400 instead of 409) which was diagnosed and fixed with a companion unit test; work was cut off mid-gate while classifying two remaining TEE-related failures as environmental.

repo: execute-phase worktrees fork from live HEAD (baseref-head), so all waves keep parallel isolation without inter-wave degrade

Root package.json has no top-level test/build scripts; pnpm typecheck is the real cross-plan integration check but intentionally fails mid-migration (e.g. Wave 1 renames API before Wave 2 fixes TS consumers) — must scope post-merge gates to each wave's actual blast radius
CI's Typecheck job runs root `pnpm typecheck` which excludes `apps/api tsc --noEmit`, so apps/api-only tsc errors are not CI-gated

sdk-e2e reads SDK_E2E_SECRET (default 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production'); vitest doesn't auto-load .env, so mismatched secrets vs API's TEST_LOGIN_SECRET cause 401 that cascade-skips later suites
Throttle limits are relaxed under NODE_ENV=test (apps/api/src/app.module.ts:56), so THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET is unneeded when API runs with NODE_ENV=test

API does not log handled 4xx responses; to see the real reason, temporarily add an axios response interceptor in packages/api-client/src/instance.ts logging err.response.data, rebuild the client chain, run once, then revert
commitlint's subject-no-parens rule is enforced only via pr-title.yml on the PR title, not on individual commits — no CI job lints per-commit subjects, and the local commit-msg hook is disabled
tee-worker (:3002) health check can be 200 while /public-key returns 401, breaking tee_key_state sync after a DB reset — this silently breaks tee-republish e2e tests unrelated to the phase under test

code.finding: D-05 same-seq CID-equivocation guard (added phase 71) threw a blanket 400 whenever embeddedSeq===dbSeq && metadataCid differs, but this also fires for a legitimate forward-CAS race (writer intended embeddedSeq=view+1 with expectedSequenceNumber=view, lost race to a concurrent writer). Fixed to fall through to the CAS UPDATE (→409) when expectedSequenceNumber === embeddedSeq - 1, preserving equivocation protection for true same-seq republish while letting genuine CAS races reach the correct 409 path.

createInvite's root-ownership gate (D-01/SC#1) duplicates ~7 lines of logic also present in shares.service.ts createShare — flagged as extractable but deferred as a post-ship todo rather than refactored on verified security-critical code.

workflow: Never trust a subagent's own compile/test claims when diagnostics (e.g. LSP E0560) disagree — settle correctness at the merged-tree post-merge gate with the full command (cargo check --all-targets), not the subagent's narrower in-worktree check

When merging parallel wave worktrees, verify disjoint files_modified before dispatch to guarantee conflict-free merges; still re-run integration gates post-merge because worktree-local checks can miss cross-plan interactions

A DB reset done to get a clean live-stack test run can have collateral effects on unrelated subsystems (e.g. wiped tee_key_state broke tee-republish tests) — worth a bounded diagnosis before blindly deferring as 'environmental'
Deterministic vs flaky regression triage: re-run the same failing test 2+ times before concluding it's a real regression vs timing flake
The commit helper in this workflow can report commit_failed while the commit actually lands — always verify via git log rather than retrying blindly (matches prior known-issue memory)

friction: Tracking-commit helper repeatedly reported false-negative commit_failed across multiple waves despite commits landing, requiring manual git log verification each time
71-03's Rust rename produced misleading E0560 diagnostics from stale LSP/intermediate worktree state that turned out to be non-issues once the merged tree was checked with cargo check --all-targets

sdk-e2e run against live stack initially failed entirely due to SDK_E2E_SECRET/TEST_LOGIN_SECRET mismatch (401 cascade-skip), requiring investigation via grep/source reading since .env values couldn't be dumped directly (secret-pattern guard blocked grep)

Stale compiled API process was already listening on :3000 (pre-phase-71 build), which would have produced a false 500 in the live D-06 race test had it not been detected and restarted from current code

Large number of non-conventional-looking commit subjects (parens in description, auto-generated merge/docs commits) triggered uncertainty about whether a filter-branch reword was needed, requiring extra investigation into CI's actual commitlint scope
